recreation_brief: 1. Set white background. 2. Draw a thin dark-red (#A02040) double-line rectangle border inset slightly from all slide edges. 3. Top-right: draw a small pale-yellow (#FFF2A0) circle with dark outline; place bold black '24' inside. 4. Top-center: draw a black rectangle (~40% slide width); add bold yellow (#FFFF00) centered text 'Data Sets for Model' on line 1 and 'Training' on line 2. 5. Middle row: draw three equal boxes side by side — left blue (#0000CC), center green (#1E7B34), right red (#B00000). 6. In each box place bold white centered two-line text: 'Training / (e.g. 75%)', 'Validation / (e.g. 10%)', 'Testing / (e.g. 15%)'. 7. Draw three red (#C00000) curved arrows from the bottom-center of the black title box to the top-center of each colored box (left arrow curves left, center arrow straight down, right arrow curves right). 8. Under each box add bold black centered captions: 'Used to Train the / Model', 'Used for Testing during / Training (Stopping criteria)', 'Used to test / the final Model'. 9. Bottom-left: add two left-aligned red (#C00000) lines: 'Annotated and unannotated data' and 'Do you have labels for your Dataset ???'.
